body: Single version source of truth = apps/chrome-ext/public/manifest.json (line 4). 'task version:bump -- x.y.z' syncs manifest + root package.json + every packages/*/package.json + chrome-ext/package.json. Ship via Taskfile: 'task release -- x.y.z' = version:bump->clean->zip->zip:verify->cws:publish (Chrome Web Store API; needs .env CWS_* creds). No npm publish.
